what: DIAG LOG AGGREGATE: /api/diag/log_file returns at most 1000 TAIL lines, but bybit_coverage_soak.jsonl (83 MB) and position_read_state_soak.jsonl (136 MB) grow far faster than that, so the 1000-line tail spans ONE UTC day. Their closing criteria are multi-day ("at least 20 graded rows spanning at least 3 distinct UTC days", "rows accrue across at least 3 distinct UTC days", at least one verdicts_differ=true / dropped_symbol_dedupe_count>=1 row), which a tail cannot establish. MEASURED 2026-10-04: 100 and 1000-line tails are all 2026-10-04, bybit_1 only. Needs a read-only aggregate on src/web/api/routers/diag.py (e.g. GET /api/diag/log_aggregate?name=<soak>&group_by=utc_day returning per-UTC-day row counts, per-account counts, and counts of a named boolean/number field): TIER 2 (a diag route on the live web API) — needs a DISPATCHED LANE. Unblocks about 4 items: OI-20260902-BYBIT-COVERAGE-BASIS-MERGED-WITH-ARMING-DELIBERATELY-HELD-FOR-A-SOAK, OI-20260909-POSITION-READ-STATE-SOAK-DECIDES-WHETHER-THE-COLLAPSED-READ-EVER-FIRES, and the same pattern on arbitration_fanout_soak (PI-20260924-L1AUT4FF-0001) and other soak logs. Until then those items can only be graded could-not-look, never closed.
